notes.title: "DIGITAL EXORCIST" to Exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.content:
"DIGITAL EXORCIST" to Exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2025Play the Latest Demo at Makuhari Messe!


"DIGITAL EXORCIST" is officially announced to participate in Tokyo Game Show 2025 (TGS2025), held at Makuhari Messe from September 25 (Thursday) to September 28 (Sunday), 2025. Attendees will have the opportunity to experience the latest playable demo of the game at the dedicated booth, and we will also be running a campaign where those who add the game to their Wishlist will receive an original acrylic keychain. 

*Please note that numbers are limited.


Exhibition Details
Dates: September 25 (Thursday) - September 28 (Sunday), 2025

Times:

Business Days (September 25 - 26): 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Public Day (September 27): 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM

Public Day (September 28): 9:30 AM - 4:30 PM

Venue: Makuhari Messe

Booth Name: HYPER REAL

Location: Hall 11 | Booth Number E19



We look forward to welcoming you to our booth!
